query:
SELECT
  split_part(rest, '/', 1) AS "name!",
  bool_or(position('/' IN rest) = 0) AS "is_file!"
FROM (
  SELECT substr(f.path, length($1::text) + 1) AS rest
  FROM files AS f
  WHERE f.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND starts_with(f.path, $1)
    AND ($2 OR f.path = ANY($3) OR f.path LIKE ANY($4))
) AS children
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
